state synchronization.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Independent operators in a decentralized network are rational economic agents optimizing for identical market signals (e.g., cost, latency, standard SLA thresholds) and using identical commodity software/hardware. This economic and algorithmic convergence synchronizes their states and failure modes. In contrast, a single large service can enforce internal architectural diversity (diverse OS, frameworks, algorithms) and deploy internal firebreaks via top-down fiat.
